chapters.title: Where project data hides in Microsoft 365
Mapping the APIs that matter: Graph and SharePoint REST
Writing the manifest that teaches Copilot

takeaways: Project data in Microsoft 365 is scattered across Planner, SharePoint lists and Teams, and each source has its own API structure, permissions and query syntax.
A custom Copilot plugin needs precisely defined Microsoft Graph and SharePoint REST calls plus a clear manifest that maps natural-language terms to API parameters.
An app registration with least-privilege scopes, OAuth 2.0 with tested token refresh, and existing DLP rules make the plugin a governed, dependable reporting path.
hook: Project managers and Microsoft 365 developers who spend hours stitching status updates together from Planner, SharePoint and Teams will learn how to build a custom Copilot plugin that does it for them. The episode covers the API calls, the manifest and the secure authentication needed for one reliable answer.
